purpose: Dedicated registry for the Quran and its sciences, canonical readings, translations, tafsir, tajweed, recitation/audio, morphology and multilingual access. This layer is intentionally isolated from PR #541's 133x24 evidence matrix.

architecture.source: Quran Foundation / Quran.com and individually verified institutional sources
architecture.api: Official API or verified endpoint contract
architecture.acquisition: Rechercher adapter with provenance and rights checks
architecture.corpus: write only through existing governed ingestion; never direct from the service layer

separation.pr_541: isolated multilingual 133x24 evidence/matrix execution; do not modify or merge its corpus of evidence into this registry
separation.pr_558: dedicated Quran service/API registry and Quran-sciences integration layer
separation.source_registry: institutions and human-facing sources remain separate from API/service contracts
separation.corpus: no direct writes from APIs, quran.ai, or discovery services

quran_ai_service.canonical_text_rule: Never replace canonical Arabic Quran text with model-generated text.
quran_ai_service.grounding_rule: Quran text, translations and tafsir must be fetched from canonical/source-backed data before presentation.
quran_ai_service.tafsir_rule: Scholarly interpretation must be grounded in retrieved tafsir and attributed to the retrieved edition/author.
quran_ai_service.translation_rule: Translations remain distinct editions with language, author/provider and provenance; they are not treated as the Arabic Quran.
quran_ai_service.ai_rule: AI may assist discovery, search, matching and reflection only; it is not a source for canonical Quran text, translations, tafsir or qiraat.
quran_ai_service.qiraat_rule: Do not synthesize or infer a canonical reading from another riwaya. Each reading and transmitter must be independently sourced and verified.
quran_ai_service.rights_rule: Availability through quran.ai or an upstream API does not by itself grant redistribution rights.

verified_translation_inventory_from_qura.note: The edition inventory contains 31 translation editions across the listed languages. Arabic canonical Quran text is a separate content class and is not counted as a translation.

language_alignment_for_133x24.role_of_558: Provide verified Quran editions/services that can populate eligible Quran-related cells in the 133x24 matrix without altering the matrix itself.
language_alignment_for_133x24.rule: A language is not marked covered merely because quran.ai or Quran.com exists. Coverage requires an individually identified edition/resource and verified provenance and rights.
language_alignment_for_133x24.fallback: When no verified Quran resource exists for a language/cell, record the gap rather than generating an AI translation and presenting it as Quran source material.

integration_contract.service_to_adapter: quran.ai/quran.com data is read-only input to a Rechercher adapter
integration_contract.adapter_to_evidence: Every item receives source_id/service_id, edition/resource id, language, retrieval metadata, provenance and rights state.
integration_contract.evidence_to_review: No item becomes trusted corpus material solely because an API returned it.
integration_contract.review_to_corpus: Existing governed ingestion decides whether and where content can enter Corpus.
forbidden: AI-generated translation presented as an authoritative translation
AI-generated tafsir presented as scholarly tafsir
merging qiraat into one canonical text
using API access as proof of redistribution rights

quran_only_service_sections.role: tafsir catalog and verse-level scholarly commentary
tajweed annotations, colored Mushaf and educational resources
Ten Canonical Readings and transmitter-level evidence
morphology, paradigms, concordance and lexical search
verified language/resource candidates for the 133x24 matrix

official_api_contracts.authentication: OAuth2 client_credentials; content scope; x-auth-token and x-client-id
official_api_contracts.access_note: Production content requires approved app access; pre-live is limited to Al-Fatihah and Al-Baqarah.
Official developer page documents API access and API_Key registration, but the concrete transport endpoint should not be inferred until exposed by the official developer contract.

official_api_contracts.source_provenance: Al Quran Cloud terms state Quran text/audio were originally retrieved from GlobalQuran.com; Arabic text is sourced from various sources including Tanzil.net and Quran Academy.
official_api_contracts.rights_note: Arabic Quran text may be reproduced/stored/displayed for non-commercial use under current terms; translations/recitations retain source-specific rights and attribution requirements.
official_api_contracts.access_note: Free/keyless with soft per-IP rate limiting; higher-throughput/full-corpus mirror use should follow the service's contact/fair-use process.

api_surface_expansion.integration_rule: API contracts remain service-layer records. Each content edition/reading/translation remains independently provenance- and rights-verified before acquisition or Corpus admission.

institutional_resource_verification.provider: King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex
institutional_resource_verification.provenance_note: Official complex technical guide documents digital Quran formats and developer-oriented resources; do not convert these downloads into an API claim.

institutional_resource_verification.provider: King Saud University - Ayat Electronic Quran Project
institutional_resource_verification.provenance_note: KSU page explicitly attributes Quran images to King Fahd Complex, Quran text/translations to Tanzil.net, tafsir to mosshaf.com, and recitation audio to Verse by Verse Quran; therefore KSU must not be represented as the upstream source for those assets.
Official JAKIM page documents the approved Smart Quran application and named reciters; no public API contract was verified in this scan.
